exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold a push-up position with forearms on the ground, keeping your body straight from head to heels.

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.description: Lie on your back with knees bent, lift your shoulders off the ground using your abs.

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.description: Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly, and rotate your torso side to side.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.description: Lie flat on your back and raise your legs to 90 degrees, then lower them slowly.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: In plank position, alternate bringing knees to chest in a running motion.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
exercises.description: Lie on your back, alternate bringing opposite elbow to knee in a pedaling motion.

exercises.name: Bicep Curls
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells at your sides, curl them up to shoulder level, then lower.

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.description: Place hands on bench behind you, lower your body by bending elbows, then push back up.

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.description: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other, curl up to shoulders.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.description: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower behind head, then extend back up.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-ups
exercises.description: Perform push-ups with hands close together to target triceps.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Press dumbbells from shoulder height straight up overhead.

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides until arms are parallel to the ground.

exercises.name: Front Raises
exercises.description: Raise dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.description: Start with palms facing you, press up while rotating palms forward.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.description: Pull resistance band towards your face, separating hands at the end.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.description: Lower your body by bending knees and hips, keeping back straight, then stand back up.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: Step forward and lower your body until both knees are bent at 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.description: Stand on your toes, raise your heels as high as possible, then lower.

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.description: Step up onto a bench with one foot, bring the other up, then step back down.

exercises.name: Wall Sits
exercises.description: Lean against a wall with knees bent at 90 degrees and hold the position.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.description: Perform a squat, then explosively jump up, landing softly back into squat position.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.description: Hang from bar with palms facing away, pull yourself up until chin is over bar.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Rows
exercises.description: Bend forward at hips, pull dumbbells up to your sides, squeezing shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Deadlifts
exercises.description: Lift barbell from ground by extending hips and knees, keeping back straight.

exercises.name: Superman Holds
exercises.description: Lie face down, lift arms and legs off the ground simultaneously and hold.

exercises.name: Reverse Flyes
exercises.description: Bend forward, raise dumbbells out to sides, squeezing shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: Lower your body until chest nearly touches floor, then push back up.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.description: Lie on bench, lower barbell to chest, then press back up.

exercises.name: Chest Flyes
exercises.description: Lie on bench, lower dumbbells out to sides in an arc, then bring back together.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.description: Support yourself on bars, lower body by bending elbows, then push back up.

exercises.name: Incline Push-ups
exercises.description: Place hands on elevated surface, perform push-ups at an incline.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.description: Drop to push-up position, do a push-up, jump feet to hands, then jump up.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.description: Jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead, then return to start.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.description: Run in place, bringing knees up to hip level with each step.

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.description: Bend forward, walk hands out to plank, walk feet to hands, stand up.

exercises.name: Bear Crawls
exercises.description: Crawl forward on hands and feet with knees off the ground.
